source_limits: FNC states the residual/inverse identity but omits the mesh-uniform stability proof; the local barrier and discrete maximum-principle proof are required.
MIT Lecture 6 states the uniform inverse principle and illustrates a spectral 2-norm approach; it does not supply the local max-norm constant 1/8.
MIT Lecture 5's boundary-closure discussion is about a Neumann boundary; the example states its mixed-boundary problem explicitly and is not presented as part of the zero-Dirichlet theorem.
No source supplies the exact constants 1/8, 1/12, 1/96, or the exact h/2 closure-error witness as proved local results; all are derived in the authored carriers.
